newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian envoy to France resigns.
newsitem.headline: Colombian envoy to France resigns.

text.p: Colombia's envoy to France announced on Wednesday that he was stepping down to jockey for position in upcoming elections back home.

"I've already met the president to advise him of my decision to return to the country in the near future and participate in the upcoming electoral process," Nestor Humberto Martinez said in an interview with the Caracol radio network.
Martinez, President Ernesto Samper's former justice minister, took up the prized Paris embassy post early last year.
He declined to confirm published reports that he would launch a campaign for the Bogota mayor's office.
Nationwide gubernatorial and mayoral elections are scheduled for October. They will be followed by congressional elections in March next year followed by presidential elections in May.
